text:
emily.docs: Heads-up — we need a short deprecation banner + migration note for the v1->v2 streaming change. Plan: banner goes live 2026-05-01, email to customers 2026-04-25. Need Ruby + Go snippet updates, changelog entry, and a docs smoke test. Who can own the PRs?
ben.infra: I can take the changelog entry and the ops blurb for rollout. I’ll coordinate with deploy-bot for the banner window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: banner-schedule created: 2026-05-01T08:00Z -> 2026-06-01T08:00Z (owner: ben.infra)
emily.docs: awesome. lin.ruby — can you update the Ruby streaming example? The breaking bit: v1 streamed raw text deltas, v2 sends framed events (role/meta + delta) and our old snippet prints chunk['text'] which will break. We need an example using the new enumerator API and a short note about consuming role frames.
lin.ruby: on it. Proposed Ruby snippet (short):
```ruby
resp = client.chat.stream(...)
resp.each do |ev|
  next unless ev.delta
  print ev.delta
end
```
also will add a comment about handling role/meta events.
arjun.go: I’ll do Go. For Go we should show both the streaming client and a tiny helper that flattens role frames into a single string for users migrating. Example idea: a `StreamText` wrapper that returns a channel of strings.
khai.eng-ml: Heads-up — we should call out the model-swap fallback: existing customers on model alias "embed-old" may see different tokenization when we fallback to v2 variants. Add a short note that model swap can change streaming boundaries and recommend QA on token-level tests.
emily.docs: good call. Jorge — can your QA team add a quick smoke test to the docs PR checklist that verifies (1) Ruby example prints same final text, (2) Go example collects full text, and (3) no 500s from streaming endpoint under short load? We just need lightweight checks.
jorge.qa: Yes — I’ll add a checklist item and a tiny harness. I can run it against staging after PR merge. ETA for QA sign-off: 48h after PR is ready.
emily.docs: cooldown + release notes: please use PR title format `docs(deprec): streaming framing change — v1 to v2` and include a short migration bullet. Also add a redirect on the old streaming example page to the new one.
ben.infra: deploy-bot confirms banner will include link to migration doc. I’ll add the email draft to the PR as a doc snippet.
lin.ruby: small question — should we mention the older client shim that auto-translated deltas? Many customers rely on it. Do we recommend switching off the shim now?
emily.docs: mention shim as deprecated and provide code to opt into compatibility mode, but recommend migrating to the new enumerator path. We'll keep the shim for 90 days post-banner. Add a short sample `compat: true` config snippet.
arjun.go: I’ll include a tiny compatibility wrapper in Go and mark it as temporary.
khai.eng-ml: one more: add an eval note that model-v2 may introduce an extra space/token at boundaries. Recommend running the existing prompt-suites and adding an acceptance gating for important prompts.
emily.docs: great. Owners summary: lin.ruby (ruby examples + note), arjun.go (go examples + wrapper), ben.infra (changelog + banner + email), emily.docs (PR merge + redirects + migration doc), jorge.qa (smoke tests). I’ll open the umbrella PR issue and add checkboxes. ETA: initial PRs by EOD Friday.
ben.infra: noted. I’ll also request a quick post-deploy check in #eng-sre.
lin.ruby: starting the snippet now, will push a draft in ~3h.
arjun.go: same, I’ll open a draft PR with the wrapper.
jorge.qa: will prepare the harness and share run steps.
emily.docs: thanks all — tagging this thread for visibility. :eyes: If anything blocks, drop here.
deploy-bot: banner reminder scheduled for 2026-05-01T07:45Z (15m pre-roll).
